title: Desert Slayer Dungeon (miniquest)
start: Enter a barrier on the lowest level of Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon.

items.t: Full slayer helmet, slayer helmet, masked earmuffs or face mask. Having a slayer helmet stored on the slayer helmet stand also works.
Leaf-bladed sword, spear or slayer staff with runes for slayer dart spell

rewards.t: 4000 Slayer XP (1,000 experience after every boss kill, with four boss monsters to kill)
Ability to enter four rooms, each room filled a certain creature:

steps.t: In the room with mighty banshees, pass the mystic barrier to the southwest and climb down the stairs. The quest is just about killing 4 bosses in their specific locations. Below is a recommended order.

sub.t: Use Slayer Dart and Protect from Melee prayer. If you stand far away from the Mightiest turoth, it will use Ranged-based attacks on you. Ignore the minions.
If you choose to use melee, do not forget to bring a leaf-bladed spear or sword.
Use melee and wield the mirror shield.
Use Protect from Magic prayer. Also watch your stats as they will be drained with each attack. Bring a restore potion.
Take a dose of Super strength potion and Super attack potion, a Combat potion, or Super warmaster's potion to help.

steps.t: Monstrous cave crawler (NE - top right barrier)

sub.t: Use melee and Protect from Ranged prayer. The poison from its ranged attack severely reduces the duration of any antipoison potions, including super antipoison. Every second or third hit poisons the player even with potions. An anti-poison totem will not work.

get_inside.text: Using a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll is the fastest way to get there, as it puts the player very close to the entrance of the dungeon.
Using a ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona, although this requires completion of Smoking Kills. (Players with the Slayer cape can also use its perk to teleport to Sumona.)
Use the Desert amulet 2 or higher to teleport to Nardah, then take the magic carpet to Pollnivneach.
If a player's house is in Pollnivneach, they can teleport to their house. If the player has completed Love Story, a Pollnivneach tablet can be used regardless of the player's house location.
Using the magic carpets, players can pay a fee (or ride freely using the ring of charos) to Pollnivneach.
From the Bandit Camp's lodestone, walk east to Pollnivneach, or take the shortcut in the Smoke Dungeon.
